tasks.label: publish-iis-sb
args: $site='\\68d-mmslpm\cms'; $offline=(Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().AddSeconds(60).Ticks; Set-Content -Path "$site\maintenance.flag" -Value $offline -Force; Write-Host 'Warning banner active. App still live. Waiting 60s...'; Start-Sleep -Seconds 60; Copy-Item '${workspaceFolder}\app_offline.htm' "$site\app_offline.htm" -Force; Remove-Item "$site\maintenance.flag" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host 'App offline. Publishing...'; try { dotnet publish '${workspaceFolder}\CMS.Server\CMS.Server.csproj' -c Release -o $site } finally { Remove-Item "$site\app_offline.htm" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host 'Done, app back online.' }
